FROM python:3.11-slim

RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    git \
    xvfb \
    xauth \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

RUN pip install --no-cache-dir \
    pytest \
    pytest-asyncio \
    pytest-cov \
    pytest-mock \
    anthropic \
    mcp \
    playwright \
    streamlit \
    fastapi \
    "pyautogui>=0.9" \
    python-dotenv \
    python-multipart \
    uvicorn \
    Pillow \
    jsonschema \
    boto3 \
    "google-auth<3,>=2" \
    httpx \
    setuptools \
    wheel

# Clone the repository
RUN git clone https://github.com/anthropics/claude-quickstarts.git /repo
RUN git config --global --add safe.directory /repo

# Work around macOS-only import in computer-use-best-practices (computer.py imports Quartz)
RUN python -c "import site; open(site.getsitepackages()[0]+'/Quartz.py','w').write('def _dummy(*a,**k): return None\nCGEventCreateKeyboardEvent=_dummy\nCGEventKeyboardSetUnicodeString=_dummy\nCGEventPost=_dummy\nkCGHIDEventTap=_dummy\n')"

# Fix circular import in agents/utils/connections.py (move MCPTool import to TYPE_CHECKING / lazy)
COPY /tmp/patch_connections.py /tmp/patch_connections.py
RUN python /tmp/patch_connections.py

# Root pytest config: use importlib mode (avoids conflicting 'tests' package names)
RUN printf '[pytest]\naddopts = --import-mode=importlib -p no:cacheprovider\ntestpaths = .\n' > /repo/pytest.ini

ENV DISPLAY=:99
ENV PYTHONPATH="/repo/autonomous-coding:/repo/browser-use-demo:/repo/computer-use-demo:/repo/computer-use-best-practices"
ENV PATH="/repo:$PATH"

WORKDIR /repo

CMD ["bash", "-c", "Xvfb :99 -screen 0 1280x1024x24 >/tmp/xvfb.log 2>&1 & sleep 2; pytest /repo --collect-only -q"]
